description:
Publish the next version of an organization skill that exists, from files or a Git push, like the other publish tools. A new skill starts with create_skill; a name that holds no skill is refused. files is a SKILL.md and any supporting files, each as a path and its text content, and replaces the whole skill; skill defaults to the SKILL.md frontmatter name. push is the id create_push returned and the commit you pushed, which carries any file; skill is required with it. The SKILL.md frontmatter must name the skill. Publishing under a well-known name, such as governance, security, or design-system, replaces what Valet would otherwise supply for every agent in the organization from the next read on, so do it when the user has asked to change how the organization works, and show them the content first; its first publish works without create_skill. A skill under a new name is one the default governance process finds through list_skills when its description applies.

Destructive because it replaces the previous version's content for every reader. Repeating a call with identical content mints no new version and reports deduped. Requires connecting a Valet account.

files.description: The skill's files as [{path, content}], text only, paths relative to the skill root. Must include SKILL.md, the complete definition with name and description frontmatter. Pass files or push, not both.

content.description: Required. The file's complete text content.

path.description: Required. The file's path, relative to the skill root.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to publish into. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

push.description: Publish a Git push instead of files: the id create_push returned and the commit you pushed to its branch. Use it when you can run git with network access, because it sends only what changed. Pass files or push, not both; every other argument keeps its meaning.

commit.description: Required. The full sha of the commit you pushed to the push's branch. The recipe create_push returned prints it.

skill.description: The skill's name. Required with push; with files, omit it to use the SKILL.md frontmatter name.

name: publish_skill
title: Publish an organization skill
